summary: Backend regression check after refactor of _run_estimate into helpers _calibrate_estimate/_build_pricing (server.py) and _fit_quantity_to_budget (scope.py). Executed full E2E pytest suite (17 tests) + pricing unit tests (17 tests). All 34 tests PASS. Verified specifically: (1) GET /api/demo/seed exact numbers — hours 37/42, break_even 4100000/4600000, price_floor 5125000/5750000, options prices [3000000,5500000,6500000], scope_completeness 87, risk level 'high'; (2) POST /api/analysis/{id}/estimate with complete cost profile + full scope overrides returns price_available=true and exactly 3 options; (3) incomplete cost profile returns price_available=false, price=null, but estimate.low > 0; (4) changing scope_overrides (footage_preselected/revision_rounds) yields different low/high — overrides drive engine; (5) calibration flow: saved actual (est 20, actual 30) → apply_calibration=true returns calibration_trace with factor=1.5, confidence='low'; (6) Agreement flow: create → public projection contains price but not break_even/margin/cost_per_hour/owner_id/brief; respond 'setuju' → APPROVED; snapshot immutable across re-fetch; (7) Prompt-injection resistance — /api/analyze does not emit price or 'system prompt' text and still extracts fields. Behavior is byte-identical to iteration_1.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean and behavior-preserving. _calibrate_estimate is a pure function returning (adjusted_est, trace) — good testability. _build_pricing correctly gates options/whatsapp/decline behind client_budget presence. _fit_quantity_to_budget encapsulates the Option-A shrink loop clearly.

Confirmed the code-review 'undefined variable' claims (pricing.py level/reason, ai_service.py parsed) are FALSE POSITIVES — all branches assign level/reason before use; parsed is inside a try where the except re-raises, so it is always defined at the return.
server.py is still ~761 lines — same recommendation as iteration_1: split routers as new features are added.
No new lint issues introduced by refactor.
test_credentials: JWT: raka@baseline.app / baseline123 (pre-registered). Tests auto-register disposable users raka_<uuid>@baseline.app / baseline123.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Disposable users/analyses/agreements created per run.
